description: Photography of La Alcatraz (White Lily) by Mym Tuma. Mym Tuma, also known as Marilynn Thuma, corresponded with Georgia O'Keeffe from 1964 to 1973. This photograph, and fourteen others, were probably enclosed in a letter from Marilynn Thuma dated September 4, 1970.
imageCaption: Unknown. La Alcatraz (White Lily) by Mym Tuma, Circa 1970. color photograph, 6 7/8 x 4 7/8. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation. © Mym Tuma. [2006.6.217]
title: La Alcatraz (White Lily) by Mym Tuma
